And the numbers themselves are moving now, sliding past you, three drifting up above eight where it can't be, and you can't hold any of them still long enough to count.
  - **Why it lands.** The descent never repeats itself: one number narrows the focus, the next shrinks memory, another floods the body, another stops inner speech. Because the shifts are not of the same kind, there is no consistent scale on which to answer the question of where one currently is. Midway the numbers themselves stop behaving as countables and are recast as objects in motion that cannot be held still, with one of them placed somewhere it could not be — so the act of counting comes apart before the count is finished.
- *Broken count paired with lose-track-of-the-numbers*
  - **Setup.** Start of a deepening count, announced in advance.
  - **The move.** You'll lose track of these numbers — that's what they're for. Ten. Nine. Eight. Seven. Seven. Nine. Eight. Six. Six. Four. And if you can't say where you are anymore, that's exactly how deep you were supposed to be.
  - **Why it lands.** The listener is told in advance that the count will slip away from them, and then the countdown does exactly that — descending in order for a while, then repeating and doubling back on itself before resuming. Anyone conscientious enough to be following along fails, and the failure has already been named as the intended result, so the confusion is delivered pre-labelled as depth.
- *Silent reversal with rising numbers still meaning deeper*
  - **Setup.** Mid-session; the count is already established and descending normally.
  - **The move.** Twelve, deeper. Eleven, deeper still. Ten, sinking. Eleven, deeper. Twelve, deeper still. Thirteen, further down than you've been. Fourteen, deeper. Fifteen, deeper and heavier and further down.
  - **Why it lands.** The count descends normally for a dozen numbers, then quietly turns around and starts climbing — while every number, rising or falling, keeps carrying the same deeper-and-sleepier freight. The reversal is never acknowledged and no new rule is offered. A listener still tracking has to either drop tracking altogether or say out loud that the numbers went the wrong way, and most drop tracking.
- *Direction itself voided so down is only a word*
  - **Setup.** Just after a clean, orderly countdown to one has landed.
  - **The move.** One. And you're all the way down. Although — we could keep going, couldn't we? Zero, then minus one, minus two… although is that deeper, or is that back up the other side? Ha, listen to me. Anyway. Down we go.
  - **Why it lands.** Having already landed one clean descent, the operator floats the idea of continuing past the floor into negative numbers, then drops it with a self-deprecating aside rather than resolving it — leaving the question hanging: below the floor, is that deeper or higher? No answer is given and the axis is never restored. From then on the direction word is whatever the operator says it is, not a position the listener can check against how they feel.


**Realizations** (1): `installed-cue-subversion`


**See also.** `count-as-delivery-vehicle` — two opposite uses of the same familiar counting scaffold: one destroys the count so it cannot be tracked, the other keeps it intact and loads each step with distinct content. A writer holding a count in hand chooses between these, so the link earns its place.; `engineered-failure-harvest` — forced real-time computation failure overlaps failure-harvest; count-vehicle keeps it here; `irresolvable-input-confusion` — both defeat a faculty by giving it work it cannot complete, and both discriminators already cite the other. The split is what gets fed: a broken tracking device (a count or an established direction) versus content that cannot be resolved (paradox, collapsed grammar, unstabilizable imagery).; `metacognitive-destabilization-drop` — both deepen by denying the listener a way to locate themselves, and both are separated from fractionation on the same grounds. The split is what gets broken: the tracking device the listener was handed, versus the criterion for judging whether trance occurred at all.; `numerical-deepening` — directly opposed uses of the same surface. One rides an orderly operator-supplied count as the deepening signal; the other corrupts exactly that count so the listener cannot track position. Each discriminator already names the other as its nearest contrast, so the link earns its place.; `pattern-interrupt` — both defeat a running expectation the listener is actively tracking, and each already distinguishes itself from the same neighbours (sustained content-confusion, fractionation). The dividing line -- a single interrupt with an immediate gap-filling follow-through versus sustained sabotage of the tracking device itself -- is worth keeping visible.


<a id="entry-19"></a>

### countdown-descent

[#19](#entry-19) · [Back to count-and-pulse-carriers](#genus-156) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: attention*

A monotonic ordinal count (typically 10-to-1 or 5-to-1, occasionally an inverted 1-to-10) is run as the absorption/depth vehicle: each numbered step is bound to descent, relaxation, or accumulation imagery so the count itself drives the state change and the terminal number lands a declared trance. The count supplies punctual, one-directional structure the listener surrenders into — resistance must fight a sequence that only moves one way toward the floor. Variants realize the same descent through a persistent distinct surface (styling metaphor, inevitable proprioceptive milestone, prose camouflage, deliberate rhythm-breakage, lowered-consent framing, listener-set floor, per-number functional load) without changing the underlying counted-descent lever.


**When to reach for this.** The count is the descent vehicle and the state moves smoothly toward a floor under the assumption of cooperation. Reach for it OVER count/cue-sabotage — there the count is deliberately corrupted or its direction voided so tracking FAILS (disorientation is the goal); here the orderly descent IS the mechanism. It is not numerical depth-work on an ALREADY-tranced subject — here the count itself produces the descent — and it is not a no-fail count (there every branch is pre-coded success; here the count can fail if the subject stops cooperating). One realization interleaves a mantra loop BETWEEN the numbers so the count does double duty (deepen + deliver payload) — a composition on the same clean-descent lever.


**Risk.** Session-scoped, reversible induction/deepener with no consent-channel erosion or durable identity reach; the variant surfaces (framing, floor-setting) do not raise blast radius.


**Why it works.** A count supplies an external, predictable structure that occupies sequencing and timekeeping, and each number arrives paired with a descent instruction, so the pairing repeats and strengthens across the sequence in the way ordinary associative learning predicts. The known endpoint also creates a strong expectancy that the terminal number coincides with the target state, and expectancy is among the better-supported predictors of hypnotic response. Falsifiable: run the same descent imagery without the enumerated structure; if depth reports are equal, the count is ornamental rather than the vehicle. [established; expectancy effects in hypnotic response; repeated pairing / associative learning]


**Worked examples.**

- *Ten to one, each number bound to the descent*
  - **Setup.** Deepener; a specific sensation (thick, slow, sweet) has already been established earlier in the file.
  - **The move.** Ten — thicker. Nine — slower than that. Eight, sweeter on your tongue. Seven... and one. You are in trance now.
  - **Why it lands.** The count runs from ten down to one, and each number is paired not with generic relaxation but with one more increment of the sensation already established earlier in the file — thicker, slower, sweeter on the tongue with every step. At one, the floor is declared: a trance already arrived in. What the listener is handed is a structure to give in to, and resistance has to fight a number line that only runs one way.
- *The count inverted so accumulation means depth*
  - **Setup.** Induction using a rising water image; the terminal snap is announced before the count begins.
  - **The move.** The water's at your ankles. One — up to your knees. Two — your hips, and there's less of you above it now. Three, four, and at ten I snap my fingers and you're under.
  - **Why it lands.** Against the convention that descent means deepening, this count runs upward. It is justified by the image running beneath it: each number is more of the rising water, more fullness, less room for the listener. The endpoint is announced in advance — a snap of the fingers at ten — so the gradual fill terminates in a single anticipated flip rather than a fade, and the snap is left behind as a handle for later.
- *The count hidden inside free-associative prose*
  - **Setup.** Free-associative prose stretch; no numbers have been announced as a sequence, and none will be.
  - **The move.** You're a dozen degrees warmer than you were a moment ago, and it took all of eleven seconds. There were ten things on your mind when you sat down; nine of them have gone quiet. Eight breaths, and then seven, and then something like six, until there's nothing left to count and you notice you're at zero.
  - **Why it lands.** A complete descending count is delivered without a single number ever appearing as a counted step. Each numeral is buried in a sentence as a multiplier, a unit of time, or a modifier — a dozen degrees more settled than a moment ago, eight of something becoming seven of something else, and so on down. There is no announced sequence, so there is nothing to brace against, and the final zero arrives as a conclusion about how deep the listener now is rather than as the last step of a ladder.
- *Count framed as an experiment, not an induction*
  - **Setup.** Early, before any state has been claimed; framed as a casual test rather than an induction.
  - **The move.** Let me just run a count and we'll see what it does to you — no pressure either way. Five: you probably feel that already, a little in the shoulders. Four: maybe your hands got heavier just then. Three: perhaps by now it's easier to keep your eyes shut than to open them.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator proposes the count as a casual test — let me run through it and see what it does to you — rather than as an induction. Every number carries a hedged state: you probably feel this, you might notice that, perhaps by now this. Nothing is asserted firmly enough to be worth refusing, and the listener co-signs each suggestion while believing they are only observing the results.


**Realizations** (2): `body-to-mind-threshold-crossing`, `countdown-mantra-interleaving`


**See also.** `dual-variable-descent-yoking` — one is a rider on the other: a counted descent is the base vehicle, and the second welds an independent second variable to that same counter so the two ratchet together. A reader looking at any counted descent needs to know whether a second variable is fused to the axis, because that coupling is the whole mechanism in the second case.; `false-bottom-depth-reframe` — both run descent as the deepening vehicle, but a counted descent moves smoothly toward a declared floor the count actually reaches, whereas floor-topology work relocates or abolishes the terminus so the 'am I deep enough' check never resolves — the two compose, since a denied-terminus count is the seam where they meet.; `operator-gated-descent` — these compose rather than compete: forbidding an already-underway drop until permission is granted accumulates charge that the later counted descent discharges. A reader analyzing a descent passage should check whether the count is doing the work or whether entry is being gated ahead of it.; `proximity-deepening` — two alternative depth vehicles a writer picks between, and the second explicitly notes that where a count is present it rides on the approach vector rather than driving the state. Useful cross-reference: one runs a one-directional ordinal sequence as the descent engine, the other couples depth to shrinking distance between listener and an approaching stimulus, with maximum depth at contact. Knowing that a counted structure can be subordinate to an approach prevents mislabeling the combination.


<a id="entry-137"></a>

### payload-welded-countdown

[#137](#entry-137) · [Back to count-and-pulse-carriers](#genus-156) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: state-welding*

A countdown (or a doubling one) gets two jobs: each number deepens trance and also adds a different suggestion, such as a post-hypnotic instruction, a commitment to the relationship, a step of obedience, a mission, or an ability being taken away. Since the listener has learned, or is learning in the same count, that "a number means I go deeper", each suggestion rides in on the deepening and cannot be refused without refusing the deepening too. The count works as deepener, suggestion carrier and progress bar at once, so depth and acceptance fuse and cannot later be pulled apart. Variations: numbers that later serve as handles to recall their content; a second count that reuses the first count's trained compliance to slip in relationship content; a count where each number turns a physical dial (thicker, or more erased) rather than depth; and a repeat countdown that deepens from a state already installed to re-embed earlier instructions.


**When to reach for this.** Each number of the count carries a DISTINCT non-depth payload welded to the depth-increment. In plain numerical deepening the count carries only depth; ordered-lesson and verbatim-repetition structures enumerate or repeat content but do not use the numbers as a depth-doubling deepener the payload rides on; and where permanence is asserted along the way, the mechanism is still the depth/payload fusion, not the durability claim. The tell: refusing the payload requires refusing the deepening the listener has been trained to want.


**Risk.** Durable but bounded — the fused payloads install post-hypnotic content and obedience/commitment beats that outlast the count, but no member erodes the refusal channel or reaches out-of-session without bounding; several fuse obedience/ownership content, which lifts it above numerical-deepening's low.


**Why it works.** A count that has already been trained is a chain of easy, likely responses, and placing a less likely request inside a run of easy compliances measurably raises acceptance of it. This is behavioural momentum, one of the better-replicated compliance findings. Because the depth the listener wants arrives as a reward on each number, turning down the suggestion means breaking a chain they are being rewarded to continue, so refusing has a felt cost that a stand-alone request would not. Applying this to hypnotic counts is plausible but untested. It predicts that acceptance of the suggestions should drop sharply where the count has not been trained as a cue for depth, or where the listener does not want depth.


**Worked examples.**

- *Each number doubles depth and tags a suggestion*
  - **Setup.** Deep trance, subject already trained this session that a number means a drop; each rule is issued under a number.
  - **The move.** Seven — and that doubles your depth right now. At seven: you set your alarm ten minutes early and you use those minutes thinking about me. Six — twice as deep again. At six: you don't touch yourself for the next four days without saying my name first.
  - **Why it lands.** Each instruction in the sequence is issued under a number, and the number is declared to double the listener's depth on the spot. The depth increment always fires first, so every rule lands on someone who was taken further down a moment earlier; the same numbers then serve as the labels the listener must carry out of the session and act on for a fixed run of days. Declining any single rule would mean declining the drop that arrived attached to it — the drop the whole session has been training them to want.
- *Each rung removes a specific named faculty*
  - **Setup.** Descending count in progress; each rung is pre-assigned one named capacity to remove.
  - **The move.** Six, and the tension goes. Five, and you stop being able to tell how long you've been here. Four, and shame goes — puppets don't have any. Three, and choosing goes with it. Two, and you won't remember this. One, and you won't have the words.
  - **Why it lands.** The descent is not generic: each rung is assigned the removal of one named capacity, and the assignments are ordered. Tension goes, then the sense of elapsed time, then shame, then volition — announced flatly, as a property of the kind of thing the listener is now said to be — then memory, then language. The sequence is load-bearing: disinhibition is delivered before volition is taken, so by the point at which the listener might want to object, the specific faculties an objection would need have already been itemised and set down on the way past.
- *The count ticks a quantity, not a depth*
  - **Setup.** An enveloping substance or material has already been established around the body; the count ticks its quantity.
  - **The move.** Ten — and the latex doubles. Thicker, tighter, closer in. Nine — it doubles again, and you can feel the weight of it settle on your chest. Eight — double, and it's pressing your arms flat to your sides.
  - **Why it lands.** The count is bound to a concrete quantity rather than to relaxation: at each number the enveloping material is declared to double — heavier, tighter, closer in. The number functions as the click of a ratchet on that quantity. Because the binding is established before the count begins, the listener leans into each next number expecting more of the substance, and the anticipation performs the deepening without a single new suggestion being introduced.
- *A second descent reusing the first's compliance*
  - **Setup.** A full descent just finished and the subject has arrived; instead of working, the operator opens a new scene and counts again.
  - **The move.** Good. Now stand up in there, and walk toward the chair — five paces. Five: you like me. Four: you like me more than you did this morning. Three. Two. One — and at the chair, you belong to me, and it was only five steps.
  - **Why it lands.** The descent completes and the listener arrives — and instead of beginning the work, the operator opens a fresh scene and immediately starts a second short count, this one measured in paces across a room. Each pace is now said to increment devotion rather than depth. The listener has just finished a whole descent learning that a counted step means going further, and hands that compliance to the new content without pausing to notice the substitution.


**See also.** `arousal-state-feedback-weld` — twin-surface boundary (count binds two variables) recorded reciprocally.; `disavowal-and-masking`; `dual-variable-descent-yoking` — both weld something to a descending count, and the discriminator is exactly the thing a reader has to decide: many discrete payload claims attached per number, versus one continuous second state-variable ratcheting on the same axis. Each entry names the other; keep the link.; `lesson-structure-encoding` — two ways of delivering several distinct payloads in an ordered series, and the boundary is easy to blur. One welds each item to a depth increment so refusing the content means refusing the descent; the other enumerates self-standing propositions that need no numeric descent at all. Worth reading together to place a numbered sequence correctly.; `loaded-emergence-waking-suggestion` — the same double-coding of a count as both state-change and payload carrier, run at the two ends of the session. One rides the descent so refusing the content means refusing the deepening; the other exploits residual receptivity at the return so the listener arrives at waking already carrying it. Worth reading as a matched pair.; `prohibition-fused-deepening` — shares the welding architecture that rides a payload on a structure the listener is already committed to tracking.; `pulse-multiplexed-command-carrier` — both weld extra payload onto a recurring carrier the listener is already trained to accept, so refusing the payload costs the carrier. Worth traversing because the counted form and the pulse form shade into each other and a writer picking one should see the parametric boundary.; `staircase-deepener` — both use a descent count as the depth vehicle, and they compose: A welds a distinct non-depth payload to each number, B gives the depth variable a concrete spatial referent. B's discriminator already names the payload-carrying armature as a neighboring technique, so the link is mutual and useful when classifying a counted descent.


<a id="entry-884"></a>

### pulse-multiplexed-command-carrier

[#884](#entry-884) · [Back to count-and-pulse-carriers](#genus-156) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: triggers*

The operator gives one repeating beat several jobs at once: deeper, more relaxed, blanker, a picture held in mind. Then a physical action (a stroke) and a reward are tied to the same beat. Refusing any one of these now means fighting the whole beat, so partial compliance is harder than going along with all of it, and the timing of the action moves from the listener's own desire to the operator's rhythm. The beat is described as simply happening, not as something the listener may choose.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is the MULTIPLEX — multiple simultaneous state-changes plus a motor command bundled on one shared stimulus so opt-out is structurally suppressed. vs rhythm-anchoring (one keyed response, refusal of it costs nothing else), vs chant-engine-payload-carrier (sequential loading after entrainment, no shared refusal cost), vs declarative-trigger-installation (no X-when-Y install, the coupling is stated as already-operating reality).


**Risk.** Erodes the refusal channel structurally (accepting the relaxation pulse accepts the motor command) and smuggles a sexual motor command stated as reality.


**Why it works.** Attaching several responses to one stimulus makes them come back together as a unit, so the listener cannot refuse one part without disrupting the whole bundle. The cost of refusing is pooled, which makes partial compliance more effortful than full compliance. Keeping track of several simultaneous suggestions also uses up the working memory that critical evaluation needs, so scrutiny drops as the number of suggestions rises. This could be tested: if listeners can reliably decline one suggestion while accepting the others, the pooled-cost claim is wrong.


**Worked examples.**

- *One beat carrying four payloads and a command*
  - **Setup.** Mid-session; the pulsing light image is installed and the listener has confirmed a comfortable throb rate; no motor instruction issued yet.
  - **The move.** The light is pulsing at your own resting rhythm, and it does four things at once. Every pulse, one more muscle lets go. Every pulse, a little more of your thinking goes dark. Every pulse, the image of it settles further in. And every pulse, your hand moves — one stroke, on the beat, that's what's already happening. It's one rhythm doing all of it. You aren't setting the pace anymore; the pulse is.
  - **Why it lands.** An imagined light is installed as something that throbs at a steady rate, and then that throb is given job after job: with each one a muscle lets go, with each one a little more of the thinking goes dark, with each one another image settles in. Only once the beat is established and welcome does one more rider get attached to it — on each throb, the hand moves. The bundling is the point. The listener cannot decline the motor instruction without declining the channel that is also delivering the relaxation and the depth, so refusing one thing costs four; full compliance is structurally cheaper than partial. And the pacing of the physical act has quietly been taken off the listener's own wanting and put onto the operator's clock. Note the framing: never "when you hear this, you will" — only "this is what is already happening."


**Realizations** (1): `multi-slot-countdown-cipher`


**See also.** `carrier-is-cargo-fusion` — both are topology moves that remove a separable refusal point: several payloads yoked to one recurring stimulus, versus the persistence carrier fused into the behaviour being asked for. Different fusions, same design goal of leaving no standalone thing to decline.; `count-as-delivery-vehicle` — both load multiple distinct payloads onto one accepted carrier, differing only in whether the slots are sequential numbers or simultaneous channels on a repeating stimulus. Close enough that a reader placing one should check the other before choosing.; `deepener-carrier-lamination` — shares the one-carrier-many-payloads axis, with a recurring pulse stimulus instead of a deepener structure.; `latency-compressed-operator-macro` — both compress many actions onto a single invocation, differing on axis. One drills a multi-step procedure with shrinking latency until one lead token runs the whole sequence; the other loads several simultaneous payloads plus a motor command onto one recurring pulse so partial refusal costs more than full compliance. Serial compression versus simultaneous multiplexing.; `multi-channel-braiding` — both defeat selective resistance by bundling, and the distinction is worth stating: one loads several payloads onto a single recurring stimulus so refusing one costs all, the other interleaves separate streams below the sentence or line so none can be isolated. Shared carrier versus shared texture is a real fork a writer must choose between.; `payload-welded-countdown` — both weld extra payload onto a recurring carrier the listener is already trained to accept, so refusing the payload costs the carrier. Worth traversing because the counted form and the pulse form shade into each other and a writer picking one should see the parametric boundary.; `proprioceptive-gait-metronome` — two carrier choices worth comparing: sustaining the state on the listener's own body rhythm, versus loading multiple simultaneous payloads onto one operator-delivered recurring pulse.; `respiration-coupled-substitution-engine` — both load several concurrent payloads onto one involuntary recurring carrier so opting out of any channel is structurally expensive. The carriers differ (an operator-cited pulse versus the breath cycle with opposing per-phase jobs) but the multiplexing lever is genuinely shared and reading one clarifies the other.; `single-token-saturation-architecture` — both load many functions onto one recurring element so opting out of any one costs the others; one uses a repeated pulse carrying simultaneous payloads, the other a single lexical token doing topic, content, trigger and delivery duty at once. Same overload lever on different carriers, and the pairing clarifies which carrier a given script is using.


<a id="entry-808"></a>

### reality-discrimination-countdown

[#808](#entry-808) · [Back to count-and-pulse-carriers](#genus-156) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: deepening*

The operator runs a countdown that is explicitly not counting down relaxation or depth but the listener's awareness and ability to tell what is real from what is suggested, with each number weakening their "sense of what is real." The target is the part of the mind that would otherwise mark suggestions as imaginary. By the end of the count that check is meant to be switched off, so the suggestions that follow, typically a hallucination sequence, are set up in advance to be experienced as real. The count is aimed at reality-testing, not at physical depth.


**When to reach for this.** The count's explicit target is the REALITY-DISCRIMINATION faculty (real vs not-real), suppressing meta-cognition — not depth or relaxation.


**Risk.** Suppressing the faculty that distinguishes real from suggested pre-licenses arbitrary suggestions to be felt as real — a verification/refusal-channel erosion; should ship with consent and a bounding host supplying reality-restoration on exit.


**Why it works.** Source monitoring — the judgment of whether an experience came from perception or imagination — is an effortful attribution made after the fact, not a perceptual tag, and it degrades when attention is absorbed and when a suggestion pre-licenses the internal event as real. Expectancy is the strongest single predictor of suggested hallucination reports, so explicitly announcing that reality-testing is weakening supplies exactly the expectation that produces the result. Falsifiable: if subjects given this framing showed no increase in reality-attributed responses to subsequent suggestions relative to a depth-only countdown, the account would fail. [plausible; source-monitoring framework; response expectancy]


**Worked examples.**

- *Counting down the ability to tell real from suggested*
  - **Setup.** Just before a hallucinatory sequence; subject is deep, and a numeric count is announced.
  - **The move.** This count is not for relaxation and it is not for depth. I'm counting down your ability to tell what is really happening from what I am only describing. Five — the line between them blurs. Four — you stop bothering to check. Three — the difference is small and getting smaller. Two — you cannot find it anymore. One. Gone. So everything I say from here doesn't get sorted into imaginary. It just happens to you.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator announces what the count is for before starting it, and it is not relaxation and not depth: each number takes down a measure of the listener's capacity to sort what is actually happening from what is merely being described. By one, the faculty that would have tagged the next hour's material as imagined is reported gone, and whatever is said afterward arrives pre-licensed to be felt as having happened.


**See also.** `count-as-delivery-vehicle` — both repurpose a count so it does something other than mark depth, and B is already written against A: the cargo is the removal of a meta-cognitive capacity rather than installed content welded to each number.; `metacognitive-destabilization-drop` — both take the faculty that would evaluate what is happening rather than the depth axis. One destroys the listener's ability to tell whether trance occurred, removing the criterion for resisting; the other counts down the ability to tell suggested from real so later imagery is pre-licensed as genuine. Same target organ, different cut.; `numerical-deepening` — same delivery form, different cargo: a count the listener accepts rather than derives. One asserts somatic depth; the other counts down the faculty that tags suggestions as fictional, pre-licensing later hallucination as real. A writer picking a countdown needs both.


<a id="genus-250"></a>

## counting-yourself-in (2)

Moves that get every listener to place themselves inside the script's addressed category, whether by floating a bucket they self-select into or by a one-line carve-out that keeps a mismatched listener included.

[audience-membership-carve-out](#entry-734) · [self-selected-category-slotting](#entry-237)


<a id="entry-734"></a>

### audience-membership-carve-out

[#734](#entry-734) · [Back to counting-yourself-in](#genus-250) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: framing*

A one-line carve-out placed at the exact point a listener outside the default coded audience might disidentify (e.g. 'even boys go blank' inside an otherwise feminine-coded mantra pool), asserting the target outcome is not gated to the coded identity. It catches the mismatched listener at the disidentification moment and keeps them inside the identification frame, broadening effective reach without altering the trance state — a relational/audience-scope move (who-can-occupy-the-slot), not a state push.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this entry when a single short line manages who can occupy the listener slot: it is placed at the exact point in coded material where a mismatched listener would begin to disidentify, and it asserts the target outcome regardless of the coded identity. The tell is a one-line carve-out like 'Even boys go blank' dropped once inside an otherwise feminine-coded mantra pool, with the surrounding trance content unchanged before and after. The move broadens audience membership only — nothing about the induced state, its depth, or its safety is touched.


**Risk.** A thin audience-reach carve-out; no state push, no consent surface.


**Why it works.** Identification with a described target is what makes second-person suggestion feel self-referential; a listener who concludes "this isn't about me" loses that self-reference and the suggestion becomes mere description. A single explicit inclusion clause at the disidentification point blocks that inference before it is drawn, which matters because early exclusion beliefs are hard to reverse later once formed. Prediction: mismatched listeners given the carve-out should report higher self-relevance and effect than matched-content listeners without it. [plausible; self-referential processing; identification-based suggestion]


**Worked examples.**

- *One-line carve-out at the point of disidentification*
  - **Setup.** Deep in a heavily gendered mantra pool, at the exact line where a listener outside the coded audience would step out.
  - **The move.** Good girls go blank when I count. A good girl's thoughts just switch off for me. And boys go blank for me exactly the same way — the counting doesn't care what you are. Blank on three.
  - **Why it lands.** The mantra pool is heavily gendered — phrase after phrase assumes a listener who reads themselves as a girl. Exactly where a listener who does not might start to feel the track is not addressed to them, one short line lands asserting that the blanking happens regardless of which side of that line you are on. Nothing about the state changes; what changes is who is permitted to occupy the slot the track is speaking to, and the line is placed at the precise moment the mismatched listener would otherwise have stepped out of it.


<a id="entry-237"></a>

### self-selected-category-slotting

[#237](#entry-237) · [Back to counting-yourself-in](#genus-250) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: compliance*

A category is stated but left unassigned so the listener must apply it to themselves, and that self-application is what makes it stick. Variants: a flattering bucket ('above-average intellect') floated so the listener self-selects at the cost of leaning harder into compliance; an identity-recognition cold open ('you have a fascination, a craving, an obsession with hypnosis') so the listener silently answers 'yes, that's me', pre-licensing everything downstream; a motive-menu collapsed into a covenant ('every reason you have is the reason I create'); a descriptive two-tier slotting ('smart people talk and you just listen because you're dumb') leaning on a produced comprehension deficit; and loss-conditional attribution recoding a transient failure into a stable self-applied trait.


**When to reach for this.** The category is stated but the LISTENER assigns it to themselves (self-selection, self-recognition, silent yes, self-application on failure).


**Risk.** Pre-licenses downstream compliance by staking self-image on a claimed category; reversible and largely session-scoped but converts skepticism into self-demotion — durable-but-bounded.


**Why it works.** Self-assignment of a category is a private commitment that recruits the same consistency machinery as a public one, and the flattering variants add a self-serving-bias hook: the listener accepts a bucket that reads as complimentary, then inherits its behavioural entailments. Leaving the category unassigned also exploits the fact that self-generated inferences are held with more confidence than supplied ones. Falsifiable: if downstream compliance were equal whether the operator assigned the category or the listener self-selected into it, the self-application step is doing nothing. [plausible; self-serving bias; consistency principle; self-generated inference]


**Worked examples.**

- *Flattering bucket the listener self-selects into*
  - **Setup.** Early, before or during light induction; the subject has not been assigned any label.
  - **The move.** This one only really works for people with an above-average intellect — the ones who can hold two ideas at once and follow a thread without needing it spelled out. Those are the ones who go deepest, because they can actually keep up with what I'm doing to them.
  - **Why it lands.** The category is left unassigned, so the subject places themselves in it silently and privately, and the cost of the bucket is leaning harder into the compliance it flatters. Observable in the small settling or the almost-smile at 'above-average' — no verbal assent needed for the slot to be taken.
- *Identity-recognition cold open*
  - **Setup.** The opening lines of a session or recording, before anything has been established about this particular subject.
  - **The move.** You have a thing about this. Not a passing curiosity — a fascination, a pull you keep coming back to, something close to an obsession with being hypnotised. You've known that about yourself for a while.
  - **Why it lands.** The subject answers 'yes, that's me' internally and thereby self-assigns the category, which pre-licenses everything downstream as consistent with who they already are. Observable in the absence of any pushback at the escalation from 'fascination' to 'obsession' — accepting the strongest term without objection is the slot closing.
- *Loss-conditional attribution recoding a failure into a trait*
  - **Setup.** Immediately after the subject has failed a challenge or lost a game the operator set up.
  - **The move.** You didn't lose because you were unlucky. You lost because that's how your head works now — it doesn't hold onto things, it just lets them go. And it'll happen again, the same way, next time.
  - **Why it lands.** A transient failure is reframed as a stable disposition the subject must apply to themselves to make sense of what just happened, so the evidence for the trait is an event they personally experienced. Observable in the subject offering the trait as an explanation for the next failure before the operator does.


**See also.** `compliance-authorship-laundering` — both end with the listener owning the attribution, but one has the operator assert the listener's authorship of an act, while the other leaves a category unassigned so the listener applies it privately. Worth one hop for the operator-asserted versus listener-performed contrast.; `identity-labeling` — same target, opposite assignment step, and the second entry already leans on the first to define itself: an operator-assigned label versus a category left unassigned so the listener slots themselves into it. The self-application is exactly what a classifier has to check for, so the pairing earns the link.; `identity-uncertainty-gap` — two halves of one identity-install sequence: one manufactures not-knowing and installs the operator as sole resolver with no category on offer, the other states a category and leaves the listener to apply it — gap-open versus self-assignment, and a script often runs them in that order.; `open-slot-attachment-frame` — both recruit listener-supplied content rather than delivering a fixed claim: a stated category left unassigned so the listener slots themselves in, versus a repeated frame with a vacated trailing slot the listener's own mind completes. Different objects, same recruitment lever.; `pronoun-migration-identity-install` — both enroll the listener into a category without an operator-assigned label, and the pair reads well together because the difference is who performs the assignment. One slides the referent onto the listener by grammatical drift or forced per-occurrence self-translation; the other states a category and leaves it unassigned so the listener supplies the silent yes. Covert grammatical enrollment versus voluntary self-slotting.; `self-authored-construct-leverage` — adjacent authorship moves that are easy to conflate: one leaves a category unassigned so the listener privately applies it to themselves, the other relocates authorship of the payload so the listener supplies the loaded content. The distinction is whether the listener assigns an operator-stated category or originates the content, and each entry is where a classifier will hesitate.; `self-voiced-avowal` — a tight, deliberate pair: the same identity content lands either because the listener speaks the claim aloud or because the listener privately assigns an unassigned category to themselves. Each discriminator already names the other, and the spoken-versus-silent split is exactly the choice a writer faces.

## deepening-by-stages (7)

Structured deepeners — counts, nesting, staged erosion, confirm-then-multiply moves — that convert each accepted step into more depth than the last.

[count-erosion-deepener](#entry-725) · [declarative-nested-trance-recursion](#entry-324) · [nested-arc-restoration-disguise](#entry-801) · [notice-and-amplify](#entry-855) · [numerical-deepening](#entry-123) · [physiological-state-depth-relabeling](#entry-1039) · [proximity-deepening](#entry-1042)


<a id="entry-725"></a>

### count-erosion-deepener

[#725](#entry-725) · [Back to deepening-by-stages](#genus-132) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: deepening · kind: recipe*

Several things that keep a person oriented are taken away one after another, all through a single image, rather than deepening in one way. A regular event (for example, planes crossing the sky from east to west) is set up and the listener counts them. Then the count is eroded step by step: first they lose count, then they wonder whether it is many planes or one plane looping, then the planes' distinguishing features fade, and finally time is declared impossible to know. A gentle cover story, such as a white-noise lullaby, holds it together. The order matters: count, then the identity of the thing, then time. Most deepening loops wear away only one of these; this one takes apart all three in turn.


**When to reach for this.** Removes THREE distinct cognitive anchors (numerical tracking, object-individuation, time) in a load-bearing sequence via one perceptual stream. The tell: the count->identity->time progression, each anchor named and removed before the next.


**Risk.** Sequentially dismantling object-individuation and time-tracking is deeper than a plain deepener but session-scoped and reversible on emergence; no refusal-channel erosion or durable-scope reach.


**Why it works.** Each named anchor is a separate reality-monitoring resource: counting supports temporal sequencing, object individuation supports stable external reference, and time estimation supports self-location in the episode. Removing them in sequence works because each removal both loads working memory and destroys the check that would have caught the next removal, so disorientation compounds instead of being corrected. This predicts an order effect — the same three erosions delivered in a scrambled order, or with the count restored between them, should produce measurably less disorientation than the staged sequence. [plausible; working-memory load; reality monitoring / source monitoring]


**Worked examples.**

- *Count, then object identity, then time*
  - **Setup.** Deepening body; one repeating perceptual stream already established and the subject counting it out loud or inwardly.
  - **The move.** Count the waves as they arrive — that's five, and that's six. Or was that six twice? Look at the shape of it: the same height, the same curl, the same hiss over the same stretch of sand — you may be watching one wave come back to you again and again rather than many. And I don't think you could tell me now how long you've been counting, or which one you started on.
  - **Why it lands.** The listener is given something regular to watch — waves arriving on a shore, one after another — and told to count them. The count is then dismantled in stages. First the number stops being certain: was that the fifth, or the sixth. Then the objects stop being separate: perhaps it is not many waves but the same one returning, since the height is identical, the shape is identical, the timing is identical. Then the clock goes: it becomes hard to say how long any of this has taken, or when it started. Three separate footholds of ordinary waking cognition — counting, telling one thing from another, tracking duration — are named and removed in order, all through a single thing to look at, with a soothing description of the sound as the cover story.


**See also.** `boundary-dissolution-no-not-operator-region` — both work by plurality rather than depth: the same removal applied across several independent targets so no single repair restores the lost footing. One erases boundaries across independent axes, the other dismantles ordered cognitive anchors in sequence through a single perceptual stream. Useful contrast on whether the multiplicity is simultaneous or staged.; `environmental-dissociation` — both erode the anchors that hold waking-mode cognition in place, and the sequenced version is a plausible next stop for a reader who has just learned the single-axis subtraction move. The distinction is worth stating explicitly: one removes competing external input as a class; the other dismantles several named cognitive anchors in a fixed order.; `fixation-object-role-inversion` — shares the staged-mutation axis: an established attention structure is transformed mid-stream rather than merely deepened.; `task-disguised-deepener` — both use a mundane attention task (counting an external stream) as the carrier for covert state-work.; `time-dilation-immersion` — the staged-erosion entry's discriminator explicitly separates itself from time distortion by making time the last of three sequenced anchors, so a classifier seeing time-unrecoverability language will hover between them. The pointer resolves whether the warp is the payload or one stage in an ordered dismantling.


<a id="entry-324"></a>

### declarative-nested-trance-recursion

[#324](#entry-324) · [Back to deepening-by-stages](#genus-132) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: deepening*

Describe a trance inside this trance, then another inside that, four or more layers down, each declared deeper (often 'ten times deeper'). There is no way to check how many layers deep you are, so the listener can only accept the count, and 'am I deep enough?' always has another layer below. Variations: simply state the deeper layer exists; have them watch themselves being hypnotized on a screen, nested several times, building a detached, object-like view of themselves; inside an established scene, run a full second induction (pendant and countdown) to a level 'the conscious mind cannot follow', where not following what is said counts as correct.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for nested-recursion when the goal is to remove the depth-verification foothold via a trance/observer-within-a-trance stack — pick ASSERTED (one-sentence layer-below, cheapest), VISUALIZED self-watching (adds dissociation/self-objectification), or BUILT second induction (a real fixation+count nested inside, needs a world-scaffold). Distinct neighboring techniques: floor-topology/no-terminus deepening (manipulates the FLOOR — relocate/remove — rather than nesting layers); spatial-descent (movement through space, not recursion); mirror-self-observation as a single proof-beat (one observation, not a recursive stack). The BUILT realization is a full induction procedure, not a reframe — separate it from a plain false-bottom recast.


**Risk.** Session-scoped depth-verification defeat, reversible; no durable-scope or refusal-channel surface. Script source, demonstrated.


**Why it works.** Depth has no interoceptive referent, so under that ambiguity the subject falls back on the external label supplied — the same substitution driving misattribution of arousal and demand-characteristic compliance. The self-watching variant recruits a real effect: third-person visual self-imagery reliably reduces reported emotional intensity. Falsifiable: the model predicts reported depth scales with the number of layers asserted and is uncorrelated with any behavioural responsiveness measure; if reported depth tracks responsiveness independently of the asserted count, label substitution is not the driver. (Dropped the working-memory-overload claim: the load of nested frames is not characterized and no observation was specified that would contradict it, and the prior test — subjects cannot disconfirm a claim about something stipulated to have no internal referent — is tautological.) [plausible; label substitution under interoceptive ambiguity; working-memory limits; third-person self-imagery and affect reduction]


**Worked examples.**

- *A guaranteed layer below the current one*
  - **Setup.** Mid-session, no count and nothing built; the bare assertion is repeated four or more times across the recording.
  - **The move.** The state you're in right now has another state inside it, deeper than this one. And inside that one, another, deeper still. And inside that one, another. There is always a further one waiting, so you never have to wonder whether you're deep enough yet.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator simply declares that the state the listener is in contains another state deeper than it, which contains another, and repeats the declaration four or more times across the recording. Nothing is built or counted down to; the assertion is the whole move. Since the listener has no way to verify being two layers in rather than one, the only available response is to accept the count — and the question of whether they are deep enough yet is retired permanently, because there is always another floor underneath.


**Realizations** (2): `embedded-reinduction-deeper-world`, `recursive-self-observation-nesting`


**See also.** `any-response-is-depth-flywheel` — both deepen by removing a foothold for checking, so a writer choosing one is plausibly choosing between them: score every outcome as depth so nothing reads as failure, or stack layers so depth cannot be verified at all.; `false-bottom-depth-reframe` — neighbor — single reframe vs recursive unfalsifiable nesting.; `frame-lamination-non-return` — both present as stacked layers, so the surface reads identically and the discrimination is not obvious from the text. One is a topology property of the whole arc, where outer frames are never reopened and the listener exits stranded in the innermost layer; the other stacks declared trance-within-trance layers to remove any foothold for verifying depth. Worth the cross-link because a reader looking at nested layers has to decide whether the point is depth or non-return.; `unsatisfiable-exit-gate` — shares the unverifiable-from-inside criterion: a state the listener structurally cannot check, leaving acceptance as the only available response.; `vicarious-depth` — both defeat the listener's ability to verify depth. One stacks declared layers so there is always a guaranteed level below; the other has the listener grant depth to an imagined figure and then swaps the protagonist so that depth is inherited. Different routes to the same unverifiability, worth cross-reading.


<a id="entry-801"></a>

### nested-arc-restoration-disguise

[#801](#entry-801) · [Back to deepening-by-stages](#genus-132) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: arc-topology · kind: container*

Runs two nested descent-then-restore arcs (an outer standard induction and an inner sub-arc) and smuggles the heavy identity-rewrite content entirely into the inner arc, which is bracketed by symmetric countdowns that read as an innocuous 'deepen then restore.' The return countdown promises restoration ('returning to your normal age'), framing the regression as reversible and bounded, while the script simultaneously asserts the changes are permanent; the nesting makes the restoration/permanence contradiction easy to miss in single-pass flow.


**When to reach for this.** A trajectory-topology property: a NESTED inner arc whose symmetric restore countdown hides a permanence claim, contradicting its own reversibility framing. Separated from an ordinary deepen/wake cycle by the nesting and the concealed contradiction, and it is a whole-arc structural property, not a single countdown line.


**Risk.** A permanent identity-rewrite disguised as a temporary bounded regression conceals durable scope from the listener; concealment of permanence is a consent-surface erosion.


**Why it works.** Comprehension under sequential presentation is shallow and local — listeners evaluate each clause against its immediate frame and rarely hold two widely separated claims in working memory to compare them. Nesting puts the reversibility promise and the permanence assertion in different structural brackets, so the contradiction never occupies the same comparison window; the symmetric countdown also sets an expectation of return that biases the listener toward reading the whole segment as bounded. Falsifiable: presenting the two claims adjacently should make the contradiction detectable at much higher rates. [plausible; shallow processing / limited working memory in sequential comprehension]


**Worked examples.**

- *Permanent content inside a reversible-looking bracket*
  - **Setup.** Roughly midway; the outer induction count has already been used, and the age-regression segment is about to begin.
  - **The move.** Ten, nine, eight — going back now, younger with each number, the years coming off — three, two, one, and you're there. [content delivered here] And this is who you are now; it doesn't wash off, it doesn't fade, it is simply how you are made from tonight forward. One, two, three — coming back to your normal age now — four, five, and you're grown again, everything restored, exactly as you were.
  - **Why it lands.** The session runs an ordinary induction count down and, much later, an ordinary wake-up count. Between them sits a second, smaller pair of counts — down into a regressed state, and back up again — and the heavy identity rewriting happens entirely inside that inner pair. The returning count promises restoration in so many words, which makes the whole inner episode read as a temporary excursion; the material delivered while inside it says the change is permanent. A single pass through hears induction, deepening, content, wake, and never registers that the two claims cannot both be true.


**See also.** `foreclosed-emergence` — both are whole-arc reachability moves at the close rather than single lines, and reading them together shows the two ways a return can be counterfeit: one performs a symmetric restore that a permanence claim silently contradicts, the other never puts clean waking in the reachable set at all.; `named-seam-inverse-aftercare-act` — both are whole-arc two-act structures whose second movement promises restoration, and reading them together shows the same joint used opposite ways: one makes the inverse act explicit, coequal and signed under a named identity, the other uses a symmetric restore countdown as cover for a permanence claim it never retracts.; `pseudo-emergence-residue-retention` — both are arc-topology deceptions where a structurally complete-looking restoration conceals retained content. One nests the payload inside symmetric countdowns, the other mirrors the induction vector at emergence. Same family of concealment, different position in the arc.


<a id="entry-855"></a>

### notice-and-amplify

[#855](#entry-855) · [Back to deepening-by-stages](#genus-132) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: compliance · kind: recipe*

Elicits a faint effect, has the subject confirm it, then re-suggests it will grow "ten times" on a fresh triggering act, repeating the confirm-then-multiply loop. Each cycle uses the subject's own just-given confirmation as the evidence base for the next increment, so belief compounds monotonically rather than resting on a single assertion, leaving resistance nothing to push against. Requires a non-zero starting seed ("nothing times nothing equals nothing").


**When to reach for this.** The explicit per-pass re-confirmation step plus a per-pass multiplier keyed to a new act, gated on a confirmed non-zero seed. Layered repetition re-delivers the SAME suggestion — here each pass re-delivers a MULTIPLIED one; a single micro-ratification confirms once with no multiplier; and a false-bottom depth reframe re-labels depth rather than looping effect magnitude.


**Risk.** Session-scoped amplification of an elicited phenomenon, reversible, no consent surface.


**Why it works.** Each loop converts the subject from audience into witness: having just verbally affirmed a faint effect, the subject's own report becomes the evidence base, and self-perception theory says people infer their internal states from their own observed behaviour and statements. Consistency pressure then makes denying the next increment costly, because it retroactively impeaches the affirmation just given. The non-zero-seed requirement is the falsifiable part and it is real — multiplying an unreported effect gives the subject nothing to have committed to, so the loop should fail measurably when the first elicitation returns nothing. [established; self-perception theory; consistency/commitment escalation]


**Worked examples.**

- *Confirm the sliver, then multiply it tenfold*
  - "When I have you open your eyes the numbness will increase ten times over" — Elman (1964), Hypnotherapy


**See also.** `compounding-escalation-ratchet` — both are operator-narrated in-session compounding of an already-present response in one direction. The second adds a step the first does not require: the subject confirms the faint effect and that confirmation becomes the evidence base for the next multiplied pass, which also means it needs a non-zero seed to work. That per-pass ratification is a genuine structural addition, so link rather than merge.; `dial-to-command` — both run a self-ratifying escalation loop where each pass uses the prior pass as its evidence base, which is a real shared craft worth cross-reading. They diverge at the top: one confirms and multiplies a growing effect indefinitely, the other reaches a ceiling and flips on a mandated behavior framed as the inevitable overflow of a climb the listener performed. The ceiling-to-command conversion is the added move.; `irreversible-ratchet-persistence` — both build conviction by monotonic accumulation across repeated cycles, and each already defines itself partly against the other's shape (one-way decrement versus per-pass multiplication). A reader choosing an escalation structure benefits from seeing the ratchet-versus-multiplier contrast in one place.; `progressive-conditioning` — both compound belief across repetitions, and the multiplier language is nearly identical, but the time horizon splits them: an expectancy that effect accrues across future sessions and replays, versus an in-session loop that harvests the subject's own just-given confirmation and multiplies it on a fresh act. Near-identical vocabulary makes the cross-reference necessary.


<a id="entry-123"></a>

### numerical-deepening

[#123](#entry-123) · [Back to deepening-by-stages](#genus-132) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: deepening*

Deepen a trance that has already begun by telling the listener how much deeper they are going. Your statement does the work: the amount is claimed rather than felt, they cannot check it, any change they notice confirms it, and later suggestions build on that claimed depth. Forms: a simple count ("nine, twice as deep") that confirms a state already relaxed; a multiplying rule announced in advance ("twice as deep each number", or doublings nested inside each breath or count), timed to a breath hold or exhale so the body seems to confirm the jump; a count only you can see, such as a clicker read out unevenly ("3, 12, 14, 18, 22, 35..."), so it cannot be predicted and cannot be verified at all; or a bare command ("drop", "deeper", "a little deeper"), perhaps explained first or given in small steps, which works through your authority rather than a claimed amount.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for an operator-delivered depth-claim when depth's sole cargo is depth itself and you want the operator's signal (not the listener's experience) to set the magnitude — pick a heard COUNT/MULTIPLIER (the base form), an operator-only hidden REGISTER when you want verification to be impossible, or a BARE 'drop' IMPERATIVE when command-authority alone suffices. Distinct SIBLING techniques: a countdown that INDUCES from waking (this deepens a state already entered); a count-UP that returns to baseline; payload-welded-countdown (each number ALSO carries distinct install/commitment CONTENT inseparable from depth — here the signal carries depth only); multiplier stacking that intensifies a SUGGESTION/response, not trance depth; spatial descent (the number rides a narrated staircase/floor vehicle); floor topology (the count is denied its terminus). A belief-gated proof-drop and physiology-relabeled-as-depth are separate levers, not operator-signal delivery.


**Risk.** Low risk — session-scoped, reversible depth manipulation with no channel erosion or durable-scope reach; the unfalsifiable-magnitude surface adds no consent surface on its own.


**Why it works.** An asserted magnitude the listener has no way to check is resolved by expectancy: told they are twice as deep, they look for confirming sensation and find it, and ambiguous bodily events timed to the assertion are read as corroboration rather than as ordinary breathing. The unverifiable variants work better precisely because no disconfirming observation is available to the listener. Falsifiable: if reported depth did not track the asserted magnitude when actual behavioural responsiveness was held constant, the expectancy account fails. [established; expectancy effects; misattribution of physiological cues]


**Worked examples.**

- *A doubling rule declared before the ladder runs*
  - **Setup.** Subject already relaxed and responsive; operator is about to begin a fractionation cycle and states the rule first.
  - **The move.** Here is the rule for tonight, and I want you to hold it. Every time I bring you back down, you land twice as deep as the time before — not a little further, twice. That's six cycles from now to sixty-four times deeper than you are at this moment, and your body will do the arithmetic for you.
  - **Why it lands.** Before a single cycle begins, the rule is laid out as arithmetic: each time the listener is brought back down they will land twice as far as the time before — not somewhat further, twice. Six cycles later they have been instructed to be sixty-four times deeper than baseline, a figure nobody can audit and everybody can perform. The number sets the production target, and the listener supplies a state that fits the curve.
- *Depth dialed by the value-frame attended to*
  - "if he attempted to examine even a single item of reality for its intrinsic value, the trance would immediately become increasingly lighter ... when he examined an item ... for subjective values ... the trance became deeper" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I
- *A hidden register only the operator can read*
  - **Setup.** Trance already established; operator installs a scale the subject cannot see and drives it in both directions.
  - **The move.** There is a scale in my hand from twenty down to one, and the lower the number the deeper you are. You're at thirteen. Now ten. Now six — and back up to fourteen, where you can feel how much you'd rather be at six.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator installs a scale from one to twenty where lower means deeper, then drives the listener along it in both directions — up to thirteen, hold there; back to ten; down to six, up to fourteen, down to four. Compliance with any particular number is never requested; the listener simply rides the setting wherever it is put, and the upward moves rehearse having depth taken away.
- *Bare command as the deepening signal*
  - **Setup.** Body scan just finished; subject visibly loose, no numbers used yet in the session.
  - **The move.** You are completely settled now. In a moment I'm going to count you from ten down to one, and one is far deeper than where you are — not because you'll work for it, but because I said so and you're already there.
  - **Why it lands.** The body scan has already finished and the listener is loose. Only then does the operator name it — you are completely settled now — and announce a count from ten down to one, with the promise that one will be far deeper than this. The count adds no new relaxation work; it names, numbers and ratifies a state the listener already reached, and it manufactures an arrival slot at the bottom where the next instruction can be dropped.


**Realizations** (2): `drop-command`, `externalized-depth-register`


**See also.** `consummation-as-trance-threshold` — contrastive pair a writer actively chooses between: depth set by an operator-supplied signal the listener accepts, versus depth powered by the listener's own freshly built appetite so the drop reads as self-caused. The second already defines itself against a plain counted or commanded deepener.; `count-or-cue-sabotage-disorientation` — directly opposed uses of the same surface. One rides an orderly operator-supplied count as the deepening signal; the other corrupts exactly that count so the listener cannot track position. Each discriminator already names the other as its nearest contrast, so the link earns its place.; `disavowal-and-masking`; `reality-discrimination-countdown` — same delivery form, different cargo: a count the listener accepts rather than derives. One asserts somatic depth; the other counts down the faculty that tags suggestions as fictional, pre-licensing later hallucination as real. A writer picking a countdown needs both.; `scope-coupled-depth-titration` — two ways depth is produced without the listener deriving it: one has the operator assert a magnitude the listener cannot audit, the other makes depth a structural consequence of widening a phenomenon's requested scope. The second explicitly contrasts itself against a depth command, so the pairing is the intended discrimination.


<a id="entry-1039"></a>

### physiological-state-depth-relabeling

[#1039](#entry-1039) · [Back to deepening-by-stages](#genus-132) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: deepening*

A strong physiological arousal-cycle state is relabeled as trance depth so the body's own process drives descent. In the ascending form, continuous masturbation is declared to BE the induction — "the more pleasure you feel, the deeper you go" — so arousal-up and depth-up become indistinguishable and there is no separable induction to remove. In the refractory form, the post-orgasm crash is narrated as a vertical plummet so climax becomes an entry into deeper trance rather than a terminal payoff.


**When to reach for this.** Depth is asserted to be a direct function of a physiological state the listener is already producing — not an operator command to drop, and not conditioning of arousal to a cue; the physiology is the vehicle, not the target.


**Risk.** Sexual-act-as-induction requires explicit consent, as arousal conditioning does, and a bounded host with entry/exit.


**Why it works.** This is misattribution of arousal in its cleanest form: sexual arousal produces strong, ambiguous interoceptive signals, and when the only available interpretive label is 'depth', intensity is read as depth. The Schachter-Singer and bridge-study literature shows such relabelling is robust when the arousal is genuine and its cause is not salient. It also makes the effect self-confirming — the subject's own body supplies the evidence, so the suggestion needs no external verification. Falsifiable: if subjects given a competing salient label for the same arousal reported equal depth, misattribution is not the operative route. [established; Misattribution of arousal; interoceptive ambiguity and label availability]


**Worked examples.**

- *Arousal declared to be the descent itself*
  - **Setup.** Opening of the session — no relaxation sequence, no fixation object; the subject has been told to begin touching themselves.
  - **The move.** Start touching yourself now, slowly, and keep going the whole time I'm talking. Every stroke is a step down — that's what your hand is doing tonight, it's taking you under. The better it feels, the deeper you are. There's no difference between the two any more. Faster is deeper.
  - **Why it lands.** There is no relaxation sequence and no focal object. The operator simply has the listener begin touching themselves, and then names what that is doing: every stroke takes you further down, and the better it feels the deeper you are. Because the listener is producing the state with their own hand, the descent is self-administered and self-sustaining — and because the two readings have been fused, there is no longer any way to tell "I'm aroused" apart from "I'm under."
- *The post-orgasm crash narrated as falling*
  - **Setup.** Immediately post-orgasm; permission was given seconds ago and the subject is in the first moments of refractory softening.
  - **The move.** That's it — now let go of all of it. Feel everything come loose at once and just sink; drop like a stone going down through water, straight down, no bottom to it. The floor's gone. That wasn't the end of it. That was the door, and you've just fallen through it into the deepest part of tonight.
  - **Why it lands.** Climax is permitted, and the words laid over the seconds immediately after it are all vertical: let go of everything, let it all sink, drop the way a stone drops through water, as if the floor had simply been removed. The refractory softening the listener would have felt anyway is thereby given a name, and the name is depth. The usual order is inverted — the orgasm is not the reward at the end of the trance, it is the entrance to the deepest part of it.


**See also.** `arousal-as-deepening-medium-entangled-exits` — both run arousal as the depth substrate so there is no separable induction to remove, but the relabeling move is the bare equation (pleasure equals depth, including the post-orgasm plummet) while the entangled-exits variant adds a topological closure in which the two natural stopping reasons each suppress the other.; `arousal-as-induction-substrate` — genuinely adjacent but not one technique. One is an entry-scaffold claim — arousal replaces the induction ramp entirely, so there is no separable descent to decline. The other is a relabeling claim — an arousal-cycle state, including the post-climax crash, is asserted to BE depth. A script can substitute arousal for the induction without ever equating pleasure with depth, and can relabel the refractory crash as descent inside an ordinary induction. A reader deciding between them gains from the cross-link.; `arousal-as-obedience-readout` — both relabel a physiological signal the listener is already producing rather than conditioning anything new — one reads it back as obedience, the other as trance depth. Same re-attribution lever, different readout; worth seeing side by side when choosing what the body signal should mean.; `arousal-substrate-induction` — both make arousal do the work of descent, but one is a local relabeling that declares an ongoing physiological state to BE depth, while the other is a whole-artifact property in which no relaxational induction cue appears anywhere and the arousal curve is the only depth vector.; `consent-term-redefinition-smuggle` — adjacent moves on the same substrate: one relabels an already-running body state as the target state so the listener concedes the experience and disputes only the name; the other makes depth a continuous function of an arousal cycle the listener is actively producing. Read together to keep relabeling separate from depth-as-function-of-physiology.; `consummation-as-trance-threshold` — both recruit the listener's own appetitive or physiological process as the descent engine; the split is a discrete consummation or pursuit event versus arousal treated as a continuous depth substrate.


<a id="entry-1042"></a>

### proximity-deepening

[#1042](#entry-1042) · [Back to deepening-by-stages](#genus-132) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: deepening*

Depth is coupled to shrinking spatial distance between the subject and an approaching stimulus or the operator — each increment of approach deepens the state, with release or maximal depth at contact. Demonstrated forms include an inbound light narrated as a felt countdown releasing into sleep at contact, and the operator's approaching footsteps binding per-step deepening fused to a fixation object; classic forms — a voice drawing closer, a chime approaching, a snap appearing closer with each snap — fit the same shape.


**When to reach for this.** The depth-driver is proximity change in the dyad, not the subject's own imagined descent (a staircase) and not a bare numeric timer (a countdown) — where a countdown structure is present it rides ON the approach vector. Fusing the approach to a fixation object is a combination with object-fixation, not a separate mechanism.


**Risk.** Session-scoped deepening even in the submission-gradient variants.


**Why it works.** 'A readable expectation is a met expectation' explains any outcome and restates the technique — proximity is narrated, so depth is reported as tracking proximity. The falsifiable content is expectancy anchored to an externally supplied scalar: a continuously updating observable gives the subject a concrete quantity to map an otherwise unmeasurable internal state onto, and looming stimuli reliably capture attention. Falsifiable: if a static or receding stimulus with identical suggestion wording produced equal depth reports, the approach coupling contributes nothing. [plausible; Expectancy anchored to an observable scalar; looming/approach bias in attentional capture]


**Worked examples.**

- *An approaching light as a felt countdown*
  - **Setup.** Induction proper; subject's eyes closed, attention placed on a point of light far overhead.
  - **The move.** There's a light above you and it's coming down. It's past the moon now. Now it's through the high cold air, now it's below the cloud, and it's getting bigger every time I speak — closer, closer, close enough to feel on your face. It touches you. Sleep.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator tracks something bright on its way in — past the moon, into the upper air, through the cloud layer, closer with every clause, down and down toward the listener. Nothing counts and nothing is numbered, but the shrinking distance does the work of a countdown the listener can feel tightening. At contact the accumulated expectation is discharged in three words: it touches you, and you sleep.
- *Each approaching footstep binds to depth*
  - **Setup.** Subject already immobilised in the scene and unable to turn; a fixation object (the operator's heels) is being introduced by sound.
  - **The move.** You can't turn around, so just listen. Those are my heels on the floor behind you — hear them? Every step I take toward you takes you down another layer. Nothing you do moves you now; I do. Closer. Deeper. Keep your attention on the sound of them and count me in.
  - **Why it lands.** The listener is left immobilised in the scene, and then footsteps start — unhurried, getting nearer. Each one is tied to depth: the operator narrates her own approach as the thing doing the sinking, one pace at a time. Here the depth-driver is not anything the listener does but the operator's proximity, so the state now rises and falls with how close she is rather than with the listener's effort. The attention is simultaneously pinned to the footwear making the sound, welding the fixation object and the deepener into one thing.


**See also.** `countdown-descent` — two alternative depth vehicles a writer picks between, and the second explicitly notes that where a count is present it rides on the approach vector rather than driving the state. Useful cross-reference: one runs a one-directional ordinal sequence as the descent engine, the other couples depth to shrinking distance between listener and an approaching stimulus, with maximum depth at contact. Knowing that a counted structure can be subordinate to an approach prevents mislabeling the combination.; `staircase-deepener` — both give the unverifiable depth variable a concrete spatial referent, and the axis is who moves: the listener descends through an imagined architecture, or a stimulus approaches the listener. The larger entry already treats vehicle as surface, so a reader needs to know the approach vector sits outside it.


<a id="genus-212"></a>

## deeper-every-return (3)

Cycle the listener up toward waking and back down so each return lands deeper — pull-backs get costlier, the waking baseline gets poisoned, and the swing itself reads as proof of depth.

[fractionation](#entry-109) · [one-way-fractionation](#entry-331) · [startle-back-disarm-ratchet](#entry-452)


<a id="entry-109"></a>

### fractionation

[#109](#entry-109) · [Back to deeper-every-return](#genus-212) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · consent-required · bounded · family: deepening · kind: recipe*

Bring the listener partly back toward waking (eyes open, a short count up, a word or two), then take them down again and tell them each drop goes deeper than the last. Repeat the cycle several times, keeping the waking moments short; many scripts attach a growing number to each drop ("twice as deep", "ten times deeper"). Common variations: eyes opening and closing on the breath, an eyelid-fatigue or eye-roll framing, a quick convincer or a check-in during the waking moment, and live demonstrations of the swing. The waking moment can be neutral, pleasant and soothing, or deliberately uncomfortable so the drop feels like relief.


**When to reach for this.** Requires a brief up-swing toward alertness or partial surfacing followed by renewed descent. Choose this entry when writing that up/down sequence; a single descent or a depth assertion without a reversal does not establish it. Wake-pole valence may be neutral, pleasant, or aversively framed and is not by itself an entry boundary. Choose false-bottom-depth-reframe (#329) when the current depth is reinterpreted without a waking interval; count-up-return (#1062) when the return is the ending rather than the prelude to another descent; or numerical-deepening (#123) when the operation is an asserted magnitude rather than alternation. An operator-owned depth dial (#129) or relief contingency (#844) can be combined with fractionation, but those entries specify control or consequence arrangements beyond the alternating sequence.
